fx_defects.description: fx_runner invocation crashed: KeyError('opened') at strategies/fx_runner.py:106 while iterating the venue book; later cron runs recovered; no positions harmed
fx_defects.root_cause: datetime.fromisoformat(book[sym]['opened']) parsed an unvalidated stamp — a venue trade without openTime (or a clobbered state cache) yields an empty string
fx_defects.fix: _parse_opened() defensive parser (returns None -> warning + age logic skipped that run); unit-tested 7/7, live dry run clean (map ticket #162)
fx_defects.status: fixed (landed live 2026-09-02, with the intraday dead-code fix #165 and the place_order/trade_id fixes #167)

fx_defects.description: fx_crashtest.json reported realized $0.00 despite 9 venue-closed fills, and max DD $572-on-$300 from a one-cycle stale mark (honest venue-derived DD: $0.21); stale position rows for already-closed trades persisted
fx_defects.root_cause: realized was only booked on our own 12h-hold closes (SL/TP closes skipped); equity marks came from local price snapshots with no venue cross-check; peak/max_dd are monotonic so the phantom persisted
fx_defects.fix: realized recomputed each run from venue ORDER_FILL pl (crash-size exit fills); unrealized from venue openTrades unrealizedPL; one-time series reset on schema migration (no last_venue_sync cursor) (map ticket #163)
fx_defects.status: fixed (landed live 2026-09-02)

fx_defects.description: intraday lane (h1-mom) crashed 11 consecutive hourly runs: UnboundLocalError('r') — place_order sat after 'continue' inside the dry branch (dead code), so real-mode runs crashed on the first positive-momentum open; lane opened nothing all day
fx_defects.root_cause: dead-code placement bug in strategies/fx_runner.py run_intraday(); plus the #162-class unguarded fromisoformat(opened)
fx_defects.fix: dead-code dedent + _parse_opened guard; landed live by human direction, lane resumed 15:39 UTC (GBP_USD 2000u) (map ticket #165)
fx_defects.status: fixed (landed live)

fx_defects.description: TUI file-backed panels (crash book, per-lane ledger, watchdog, registry, router) silently showed defaults: tui.py PROJECT = parent.parent resolved DATA to nonexistent /home/mrc/data; _read_json swallowed the errors; venue panels via /api/fx stayed live — read as 'TUI stale while the venue trades'
fx_defects.root_cause: off-by-one PROJECT derivation in tui.py:28; silent except in _read_json masked it
fx_defects.fix: PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent; landed live, collect_all verified end-to-end (map ticket #166)
fx_defects.status: fixed (landed live)

fx_defects.description: oanda place_order hardcoded status='filled' on any successful POST — venue-cancelled orders (STOP_LOSS_ON_FILL_LOSS during a fast JPY drop, 160.2→158.8) booked two phantom USD_JPY fills into fx_ledger.jsonl and a phantom position into fx_state.json; get_current_price served an unbounded cache (stale 160.198 quote twice while venue traded 158.82), which set the doomed stops; the #163 landed fix also bounded realized recompute by last_venue_sync, resetting the cumulative total hourly
fx_defects.root_cause: no orderCancelTransaction/orderRejectTransaction check in place_order; _price_cache written once and never expired (same no-TTL cache-first disease as ticket #159); since-cursor window instead of full-history recompute
fx_defects.fix: place_order rejects unless orderFillTransaction exists (venue reason surfaced to the runner log); get_current_price always fetches fresh; crashtest realized recomputes over full lane epoch; 2 phantom ledger rows removed (venue-proven cancelled), state cache rewritten from venue (map ticket #167)
fx_defects.status: fixed (landed live 2026-09-02)

fx_defects.description: fx_watchdog cycle crashed: KeyError('account') — _venue_net (strategies/fx_runner.py:100, imported by fx_watchdog) indexed ["account"] unguarded; an error-shaped venue payload (no account key) killed that cycle (first surfaced in fx_watchdog.log, caught by document_bugs.py auto-scan)
fx_defects.root_cause: #162 class: unvalidated venue payload indexing (same family as the unguarded fromisoformat('opened'))
fx_defects.fix: _venue_net uses .get('account') or {} — net 0 from a bad payload, callers defer closes on ambiguity; landed live + sandbox (map ticket #167 follow-up)
fx_defects.status: fixed (landed live 2026-09-02)

fx_defects.description: 161 fxexp ledger rows carry price 0.0 (59 on 2026-09-09, 69 on 2026-09-10, 33 on 2026-09-13): reason=rank-rebal BUY/SELL rows written as real fills with no price and empty order_id. Dry runs do NOT write the ledger (fx_expert_lane.py:451), so these came from REAL-mode runs during the venue freeze window and one unscheduled 00:11 CDT Sunday run — a fill at price 0 is not a fill. Any FIFO/PnL consumer reading these rows gets a corrupted cost basis. Fix: lane must refuse to append a fill whose price is not > 0; backfill/flag the 161 rows.
fx_defects.status: fixed 2026-09-13: both causes closed at source (dry-mode append guarded; place_order reads the venue transaction before a quote; _append_ledger refuses price<=0) and the 161 rows voided append-only (scripts/fx_ledger_repair.py). Not backfilled: the stored ids are the trades' OPENING fills, not the closes — the venue journal is the P&L authority.

fx_defects.description: fx_expert_lane --consolidate is accepted at the CLI and never used inside run() — the lifecycle 'cut' spec says 'positions close' but no tool implemented it (a cut lane refuses to start and trail-check skips it, so cut-without-flatten orphans positions). Superseded by scripts/fx_lane_flatten.py (per-tradeID closes, REAL fills only, reason=cut-flatten); used 2026-09-13 to flatten g137/g138 before their cut. Remove the dead flag at next fx_expert_lane touch.
fx_defects.status: fixed 2026-09-13: --consolidate now runs the shared flatten core (strategies/fx_flatten.py)

fx_defects.description: fx_trail_check.load_atr() computed MAX(high)/close (a ratio ~1.0, median 1.0074) while both it and fx_expert_lane treated the value as a FRACTION of price. Every trail/TP threshold was multiplied by ~1.0x price, putting triggers ~2x PRICE away - the trail could never fire. This is the real reason behind '0 triggers in 829 live runs', cited as 'the trail is wide' in trail-closer-gate-brief-2026-09-13.md. Fixed to the documented mean(high-low)/close (median 0.00526 = 0.53% of price).

fx_trail_check recorded a close and wrote a ledger row on 'orderCreateTransaction' - present even when the venue CANCELS the close (first live run: USD_TRY txn 4232 TRADE_CLOSE -> 4233 ORDER_CANCEL MARKET_HALTED; venue trade stayed open). Same lying-response class as #167. Fixed: require orderFillTransaction, log the venue cancel reason, defer venue-halted pairs. Phantom row voided append-only.

fx-trail-check.service Description said 'simulated trailing stop / TP' while the unit ran REAL (--once). The same ambiguity #258 identified as how the crossed gate stayed invisible. Description now states LIVE closes explicitly; fx_trail_check dry summary also no longer reports '0 trail exits' when legs would close.

fx_expert_lane.dry_check_fresh() returned True when the venue probe returned NO bars — i.e. a venue hiccup/failed probe silently disabled every future panel refresh (fail-OPEN on the one gate that keeps the panel current, the opposite of the docstring's stated safe default). Fixed: no bars -> refresh (False), plus a loud ValueError path from the adapter. Found during the 2026-09-14 staleness audit; no live impact was observed (the panel was current).

exchange/oanda.py get_bars() mapped unknown timeframes via _GRANULARITY.get(timeframe,'H1') — asking for 'D' (daily) silently returned HOURLY bars. This produced a false 'the venue has fresher daily data than our panel' reading during the staleness audit and would equally fool any future caller. Fixed: unmapped timeframe now raises ValueError listing the valid keys (all in-repo callers use mapped keys: 1d/1h/4h).

Deployed checkpoint g151 was trained on a 48-feature panel; the current panel builder emits 61 features (pv_carry + fred block INSERTED at index 28, nothing removed, relative order preserved). Any post-refresh real lane run would therefore have fed either the wrong width (crash) or, with a naive positional fix, the WRONG COLUMNS at the same indices — silently garbage scores. The refresh that surfaced this is exactly what tonight's 21:25 run performs, so it was armed to fail live. Fixed three ways: (1) checkpoints/{g151}.features.json records the trained feature contract (recovered from git HEAD:data/fx_expert/panel_meta.json); (2) today_weights selects those columns BY NAME (loud error if a trained feature is missing) instead of trusting panel order; (3) fxexpert/train.py now writes the same sidecar for every new checkpoint. Verified: lane dry-run scores correctly on the 61-feature panel.

Four ad-hoc candidate artifacts (hx20/hx20s23/h20_s37/h20_s53, the h=20 @ 30-day cadence experiment) store hp.rebal=5 inherited from hp U, but their headline PF (1.233-1.291) is only reproducible at rebal=30 — re-deriving from the artifact's own metadata gives PF ~1.01. This is the #255 class the repo guards against (a recorded number must re-derive from its artifacts), violated by the experiment harness rather than the loop. Found by the openrouter deflation work order (docs/agents/research/fx-deflation-h20-2026-09-15.md), which documented the rebal override as its single deviation. Fixed non-destructively: eval_rebal=30 + eval_note written into the four artifacts; hp left as-run.
fx_defects.status: fixed 2026-09-15 (metadata annotated; hp unchanged)
